description: THE CEREMONIAL LAST AIRCRAFT of the ROCAF F-104 fleet; taxied to the ceremony spot at Chingchuankang on 1998-05-22 by instructor 胡瑞鴻 and Maj Gen 葛光越 who then reported "F-104 mission complete" to the ROCAF commander; also flew as wingman on the final operational transit of 1998-05-08; delivered to Kinmen for display on 1998-07-16
museum_name: Chiang Ching-kuo Memorial Hall F-104 -- Kinmen
